description: For every supplied nonempty preordered numbered-atom Kripke model \(M\), finite subformula-closed \(\Sigma\), original world \(w\), and \(A\in\Sigma\), the specified filtration satisfies \(M_\Sigma,t_\Sigma(w)\Vdash A\) if and only if \(M,w\Vdash A\), using the shared native syntax including negation.
